name: hes related family bHLH transcription factor with YRPW motif 1
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: HEY1 encodes hairy/enhancer-of-split related with YRPW motif protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
